blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. JV Ejercito clarified on Tuesday that he is not anti-China, but he is against the recent remarks of Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan who claimed that if China chose to use force it “may easily win” in a confrontation against the Philippines. Since then Ejercito has repeatedly condemned Jing’s statement, even daring the envoy to go home. In response, the Chinese Embassy in Manila has tagged Ejercito as an “anti-China politician” along with other lawmakers who expressed disdain against Jing’s threat. “Let me be clear… I am not against China.
